sources.title: Channels or URLs to extract
sources.description: Mix public Telegram channels (https://t.me/s/name, t.me/name, @name) and ordinary URLs with HTML tables or .csv/.tsv files.

mode.title: What to read
mode.description: auto detects Telegram links and treats everything else as a table page. Force telegram or tables when a URL is ambiguous.

maxPosts.title: Max posts per channel
maxPosts.description: The public preview exposes ~20 posts per page; the Actor walks backwards with ?before=. 100 is a good default.

maxTables.title: Max tables per URL
maxTables.description: Keep the first N tables found on a page.

maxRowsPerTable.title: Max rows per table
maxRowsPerTable.description: Caps one table so a huge page cannot exhaust memory.

includeOffer.title: Include the Pro offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one final record with the unlimited browser export + WB/Ozon calculator link (TW1-CLIP) and the Plati.Market card.
